_directive: DO NOT CHANGE THE NAVIGATION UNTIL 1 JANUARY 2027. Red team 2026-08-29e, Part 0. FDA Tracker holds Bing #1 for 'pdufa calendar' with a nine-link sitelink block; we are #2 with none. Bing awards sitelinks for a stable, shallow, clearly-labelled hub structure observed consistently over months, and every nav edit resets that clock. Frozen: the bar, its labels, its order, its groupings, and the URLs behind them. Not frozen: page content, titles, meta descriptions, schema, internal links inside pages. This file is the frozen reference; tests/test_nav_frozen.py enforces it and self-expires on the date below.

changes.why: pdufa_site_src/pricing/index.html has never existed in this repository; the nav Pro link 404ed on 954 pages. The tier comparison it promises is on /developers under the heading Tiers. No price was invented and none was removed; building a real /pricing page is a commercial decision for David.

The 09-18 change was made on a false premise. /pricing has been live throughout: pdufa_site_src/vercel.json rewrites /pricing to /pricing.html (and redirects /pricing.html and /pricing-elite to it). The dead-link guard resolved only <path>/index.html and never read the routing table. The nav is restored exactly as frozen on 2026-08-29; the guard and fixer now resolve through site_routes.py.
